title: Orunmila retention log header, schema version 1
description: The first line of the retention log, where its hash chain starts. Old sessions are removed only whole, and each removal is written to this hash-chained log, so a removal can never look like a session that never existed. Removal records follow (retention-removal.schema.json).
$comment: brief v4 line 348 asks for the log and names no fields: every field name here is the agent's choice (LD66; as schemas, LD77). Written by src/opon/ledger/retention.js, not wired. Unknown fields are allowed, as in the other v1 drafts (LD17).

record.description: Marks this line as the retention log's header, so a reader tells it from a removal without guessing.

seq.description: The header is the log's first record; removals follow from seq 1.

created_at.description: Wall-clock time of the first removal, which created the log, by the caller's clock.
created_at.$comment: agent's choice, LD66; the form of the session header's observed_at

prev_hash.description: The hash chain starts from the header, so it has no previous hash.

hash.description: The header's own hash; the first removal's prev_hash.
